steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Yoshitsune, stay back!

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Resentful growl)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Alright, fine, wanna go in together?

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Excited battle howl)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Heh, I read that move just now, Lord of Thunder!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Yoshitsune!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hah, I'm not gonna let you have your way that easy!

steps.name: Lord of Thunder
steps.text: (Angry howl)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You're strong, alright. So strong, you made me wanna get stronger.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: But you've still got plenty up your sleeve, yeah?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: So c'mon, Lord of Thunder, I caught up to you. Now show me a stronger you.

spans.text: So c'mon, Lord of Thunder, I caught up to you. Now show me a stronger
you.

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Warning growl)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Heheh, same move again? Bring it!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Whatcha think of that, Yoshitsune?!

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Grudging snort of acknowledgement)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Dang, you're a real stick-in-the-mud!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Still...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Orchid!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Remember when you told me I'd never figure out what works for me if I don't try?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What about it?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: See, I always found it weird how you thought there was some sort of, like, answer to life. 'Cause I never did.

spans.text: See, I always found it weird how you thought there was some sort of, like,
answer
to life. 'Cause I never did.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: And, what? Now it's dawned on you?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Dunno.

a.text: Is it now?
Is this the very moment ?
Catapult doesn't know.
All she knows is something hot is coursing fervently through her body.
She must be smiling right now. Beaming with joy.

steps.name: Samurai Attendant
steps.text: Shogun, are you not joining the hunt?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: ...No. For now, I haven't the right.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: This hunt belongs to Her Majesty and the Iju Hunters.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: But... as I said before, I have made a mistake, and now is the best opportunity to make up for it.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I wish for you to witness this hunt with me. To carve it into your hearts, never to be forgotten.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: And then, return to our capital with all you have witnessed, and pass it on.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: For ten years, in our bid to survive, we have all but forgotten what it means to hunt... It's time we knew it again.

steps.name: Samurai Attendant
steps.text: Sir!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Orchid, it's headed for you!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I can see that!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Honestly... Look how much fun you're having.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: She's adapted completely to the Zinogre's attack patterns... Her respawnse to every move is textbook.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Orchid, we can't be dragging our paws either!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Why would I need to compete with her?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Because that's how hunters train their skills and claw their way to greater heights!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Since when was I a hunter? Did I miss the memo?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Still...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It's nice to limber up every once in a while.
She feels the rush of air as the Lord of Thunder's claws swoosh past her ears, and though she couldn't tell you why, a corner of her mouth lifts.
She raises her bow, and looses her arrow.
A yelp of pain follows. It surprises her to realize she had already identified the Lord of Thunder's weaknesses well in advance. She's grown oddly used to handling this bow.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: I don't know why, but whenever I see Orchid smile, I get this chill down my spine...

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Hey, if you need help in there, just give me a holler!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: The Suponosuke Dragonator's primed and ready to fire!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Tch. They can't hear me—they're out there getting hunt-drunk. Well, no work for you today, Dragonator.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hofukaru, incoming! Get behind me!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Understood!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Now!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Hiiiyaaaaah—!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: *huff*, *huff*—

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: It worked! The meownster's body is yielding to the Wirebugs!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Meow or never, Your Meowjesty!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Use Wyvern Riding on it, Hofukaru! We'll take it the rest of the way!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Go, Hofukaru!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Put an end to this!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Understood!
Under Hofukaru's control, the Lord of Thunder leaps up high, all the way up to a towering perch.
Atop there, Hofukaru's body begins to emit a blue light, bright and pale like the full moon in the gloom.
The Lord of Thunder howls at the heavens, where dark clouds gather as if to threaten a lightning storm.
A second later, the energy beam blazing from Hofukaru's eye shoots forth, combining with the bolts called down by the Lord of Thunder as they crisscross into the Gyorin's core.
What comes next is a sight none will forget for the rest of their lives—
The beam and the bolts are utterly engulfed. Then, in the dead center of the Gyorin, a tiny dot appears.
No, nothing has 'appeared'. It is more of an absence, where a hole is torn in space. Slowly, it expands, until it fills the Gyorin.
And then, from the Gyorin, a colorless pulse explodes outward.
Everywhere it reaches, cursed beasts topple one after another, and the marks the curse has left on them gradually fade away.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: The curse has been completely eliminated!

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Joyous howl)

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Your Majesty! You've done it!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Hah, so that's how you use the Gyorin! Guess we've never really understood the thing!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: That's gotta be mission complete, right?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Wait, what's that? Inside the Gyorin, there's—
Before Orchid can finish, a beam of light fires out from the yawning hole and strikes directly below the Gyorin, enveloping all in the process.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Where...?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I remember... being struck by a light... one that felt... so close to the power within me...

a.text: Well done.

spans.text: Well done.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: That voice... Mother?!

a.text: Hofukaru, my daughter. Thou hast succeeded.

spans.text: Hofukaru, my daughter. Thou hast succeeded.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Mother, it truly is thee!

a.text: How I apologize, my Hofukaru. Would that I could have returned to thy side, such burdens would not have been thine to bear.

spans.text: How I apologize, my Hofukaru. Would that I could have returned to thy side, such burdens would not have been thine to bear.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: What happened, Mother?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: What bid thee, in the end, give up thy power to the Lord of Thunder?

a.text: In the course of hunting it, I came upon our ancestors' ruins here, where I became privy to a truth of the Gyorin—

spans.text: In the course of hunting it, I came upon our ancestors' ruins here, where I became privy to a truth of the Gyorin—

a.text: It was by the Gyorin that our ancestors arrived on this land and founded Houei, and it is our very bloodline that controls it.

spans.text: It was by the Gyorin that our ancestors arrived on this land and founded Houei, and it is our very bloodline that controls it.

a.text: Yet in the passage of time, the Gyorin lost a vast portion of its energy, and began to discharge the curse without end, precipitating a great calamity.

spans.text: Yet in the passage of time, the Gyorin lost a vast portion of its energy, and began to discharge the curse without end, precipitating a great calamity.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: And that would be... the one that nearly annihilated Houei, as recorded in the history annals.

a.text: Indeed, it was our two ancestors who put an end to that calamity.

spans.text: Indeed, it was our two ancestors who put an end to that calamity.

a.text: At the cost of their lives, they fully activated the Gyorin, and only then was the curse obliterated.

spans.text: At the cost of their lives, they fully activated the Gyorin, and only then was the curse obliterated.

a.text: It all happened far too suddenly. The lone young miko they left behind was sent to safer lands, and worse still, Houei lost far too much of its history and heritage to the calamity.

spans.text: It all happened far too suddenly. The lone young miko they left behind was sent to safer lands, and worse still, Houei lost far too much of its history and heritage to the calamity.

a.text: They could not even leave behind the truth of what had happened.

spans.text: They could not even leave behind the truth of what had happened.

a.text: So I must make a guess here: that they could not fully repair the Gyorin, and could only use their powers to prevent it from leaking the curse for a time.

spans.text: So I must make a guess here: that they could not fully repair the Gyorin, and could only use their powers to prevent it from leaking the curse for a time.

a.text: Thus, the Gyorin became as you see it now.

spans.text: Thus, the Gyorin became as you see it now.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Thou meanest to say... the Gyorin was the source of it all? All the trials, they were mere accidents caused by the damaged Gyorin?!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Did we simply mistake the Iju as our enemy, and the Iju Hunters our allies? Be... be this all the case, are Houei's heritages...?

a.text: What of them? Oh, Hofukaru, daughter of mine.

spans.text: What of them? Oh, Hofukaru, daughter of mine.

a.text: Even so, survival of the fittest is still the law of nature.

spans.text: Even so, survival of the fittest is still the law of nature.

a.text: Be it trial or accident, whichever thou preferest, the hunt has remained the thread connecting our bloodline to this day. Who can tell us we were wrong to do so?

spans.text: Be it trial or accident, whichever thou preferest, the hunt has remained the thread connecting our bloodline to this day. Who can tell us we were wrong to do so?

a.text: But when I discovered these ruins, I came to realize it was not long until the Gyorin would next burst.

spans.text: But when I discovered these ruins, I came to realize it was not long until the Gyorin would next burst.

a.text: Yet I had already been deeply tainted by the curse. Even lucid thought I found hard to maintain. That was why I made that decision.

spans.text: Yet I had already been deeply tainted by the curse. Even lucid thought I found hard to maintain. That was why I made that decision.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: And so thou chosest to grant the Lord of Thunder thy power, until the time when I or a successor would discover its secret.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: For it was strong enough, could absorb enough of the curse... and thus it could unleash even greater miko powers...

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: So that if I proved myself able to fully absorb the miko powers from it, then I too could pay the cost of mine own life, and this time fully activate the Gyorin.

a.text: Thou wouldst insist that this to be the only true way, wouldst thou not?

spans.text: Thou wouldst insist that this to be the only true way, wouldst thou not?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I... would not. Nay, of course I would not.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: But this is my mission.

a.text: To thee I left the ruler's charge and the miko's calling, yet I did not teach thee how to share the weight of these burdens with others.

spans.text: To thee I left the ruler's charge and the miko's calling, yet I did not teach thee how to share the weight of these burdens with others.

a.text: To Midnight I left the duty of supporting your rule, yet I did not teach him how to work hand in hand with you.

spans.text: To Midnight I left the duty of supporting your rule, yet I did not teach him how to work hand in hand with you.

a.text: The blame is mine to bear.

spans.text: The blame is mine to bear.

a.text: ...No, I imagine I may have failed, even were I alive to this day.

spans.text: ...No, I imagine I may have failed, even were I alive to this day.

a.text: We are so alike, Hofukaru.

spans.text: We are so alike, Hofukaru.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Whuh...?
Hofukaru notices a Thunderbug alighted atop her shoulder, and her body moves independently of her will.

steps.name: 'Hofukaru'
steps.text: (Mother is controlling my body?!)

steps.name: 'Hofukaru'
steps.text: In my final moments, I made the decision to leave the Lord of Thunder my power.

steps.name: 'Hofukaru'
steps.text: Naturally, a miko's power cannot be so easily passed on. Only in the briefest instant between life and death could I manage it.

steps.name: 'Hofukaru'
steps.text: And so, of my own accord, I came before the Lord of Thunder.

steps.name: 'Hofukaru'
steps.text: We are the people of Houei. By Heaven's will shall we abide, o'er hunts of beasts shall we preside.

steps.name: 'Hofukaru'
steps.text: I stood before the Lord of Thunder with what sanity I had left, and thought my heart would be at ease.

steps.name: 'Hofukaru'
steps.text: To stake one's life on killing one's quarry is to show it respect. To die at its hands is to die a hunter. This I thought.

steps.name: 'Hofukaru'
steps.text: But I was wrong.
'Hofukaru' readies herself, charges at the Lord of Thunder, and puts all her might into a single swing.
A moment later, a thick fog enshrouds all, and everything dissolves like foam and shadow.

a.text: The instant before it all ended, I thought to myself—

spans.text: The instant before it all ended, I thought to myself—

a.text: If only I had believed in Masamune and Yoshitsune a little more. If only I had relied on Midnight a little more. Perhaps... things would not have turned out this way.

spans.text: If only I had believed in Masamune and Yoshitsune a little more. If only I had relied on Midnight a little more. Perhaps... things would not have turned out this way.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hofukaru?!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: How did you...

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Madam Catapult?! Madam Orchid?! Where am I?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What happened to the Lord of Thunder?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I can no longer sense its aura.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Perhaps... it has returned to its homeland.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Hm. Something tells me this may be our ticket home too.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Now you mention it, this place does kinda ring a... wait, this is the bamboo grove we came to Houei through, isn't it?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...So it is. About time we returned, then.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Huh? What the—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Haha! I can hear the sandstorm!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: We're going home, Orchid!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It seems our mission here is finally at an end.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Wait, I... I have not bid thee a proper farewell!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Goodbyes always come suddenly, Hofukaru.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Back in our lands, there's a girl just like you in need of help, and she's waiting for us.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I have made so much trouble for you in my willfulness. I cannot thank you enough, for bearing with me.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Aw, don't be like that! Personally, I've been having the time of my life!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...Me too.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: If this was all a dream, then it's the most wonderful dream I've had in a while.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Orchid, the sandstorm's getting quieter! We've gotta hop!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Hofukaru, remember this.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You're strong, and strong-willed to match. I'm sure you can handle most things on your own.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Life is a process of learning that you can't handle everything by yourself.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That realization will come back to you one day, and when it does, I want you to ask for help from the people around you. Okay?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Or else I'll have to kindly ask the Gyorin to let me through so I can give you another rap on the head.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ...As you wish.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Nice one, Orchid! A nag until the very end!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Yes, that's me. Do you hate it?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Nah, I love it!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Alright, come on. We'll be late at this rate.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Hold your Kirin! What about us?!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Oh, shoot! We almost forgot about you two!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Your mission is at an end too, isn't it?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: The threat of the Lord of Thunder is gone, and it seems that 'curse' was no Frenzy after all! That purr-nicious pathogen could never cause all this!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Yes, Yoshitsune and I have seen our duty through... but what we don't see is a way back to Kamura Village!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Hofukaru, are you able to open the Gyorin again?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: No. I can sense its power is fully lost now. To reactivate it would take a long, long time.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: How long?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I do not know... and what is more, I have learned that to activate it rashly ends well for none.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: What can we paw-ssibly do, then?!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Uh, might as well come with us for now!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Maybe Kamura is in Higashi or something!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Very well! As Meowcenaries, exploring the unknown is always part of our mission!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Purr-haps we'll surprise our Kamura Village compatriots with some never-before-seen souvenirs!

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Growl of agreement)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Settled!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Your Meowjesty, we bid you farewell!

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Parting howl)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Bye-bye, Hofukaru! Take care of yourself!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: And don't push yourself.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Farewell.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I will never forget you.
